description: This file defines the CustomerFacade interface, which acts as a bridge between CustomerService and controllers, handling customer data retrieval, cart merging, address management, and customer model population within the sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerFacade
classes.description: Interface acting as a bridge between customer service and controllers, managing customer data, cart merging, address handling, and customer model population.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer data based on username and store, returning a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by ID, store, and language, returning a ReadableCustomer.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges customer shopping cart with session cart during authentication, converting Customer to CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves Customer object by username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists in the store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer, returning a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves address for a user, based on user ID, store, and address type.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates address information for a user.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties on a Customer model based on the store.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a customer with username and password.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Creates a Customer model from PersistableCustomer, store, and language.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates a Customer model with data from PersistableCustomer.
